body:
## DM-270 attempt 2 (fix round) evidence detail (worker)

New commits on `space-DM-270`: 867d389 (N3 checkout), d48bbe1 (B1, B2, B3, N1, N3, N4, N5), merges 27c4aec and e21a1c8 of space-sprint-1 (DM-268 and DM-269; one doc-comment conflict in importer.ts upsertReportsAndCheckpoints resolved by combining both texts). Earlier commits ffc871f, 4efeaa3, cc03a20, b112948 unchanged; attempt-1 map (comment cm_01m7j840hyjq2ggy2r0069qqn7) still holds, with these additions.

### Rejection items
- **B1 (DM-187 regression)**: services/experimentOutcomes.ts correctionHolders keeps draft-only holders again (listed with their tickets, linkable: 'Held in … Open it'); resultEpics takes results only from saved holders; plan/experimentOutcome.ts landingOf(sourceEpicId) ignores work tickets held only in another epic's draft ('corrective work … is only in an unsaved draft of another epic'). Tests: experimentOutcomes.test.ts 'DM-270 R3 / DM-187: a draft in another epic is listed, but never changes an outcome' (forged draft listed with revision null, landing/comparisons/classification/decidedBy unchanged; an unsaved follow-up from createCorrections lists its tickets without landing). scratch/DM-187/c1-chain.ts: ALL CHECKS PASSED ('Open it opens the follow-up epic').
- **B2 (third machine locked out)**: importer.ts rewrittenEvent adopts the incoming number when a stored event differs only in `number` (incoming sequence is contiguous by schema); 'takes number N' still refused when the holder arrives with other changes; insertExperimentEvents renumbers in two steps so no move collides. Tests: experimentEvents.test.ts 'DM-270 R1: a third machine follows a fork another machine resolved' (the repro: C imported B's result #1, Git keeps A's file, B renumbers to #2 and re-exports, C imports [status #1, result #2] with no rejection) + control (C sees A's file first). docs/architecture.md updated.
- **B3 (vagueness)**: plan/experiments.ts DEFERRED = leading `to be (decided|determined|defined|confirmed|discussed|agreed|clarified|specified)` only; bare soon/eventually/sometime/later on and mid-body tbd/tba no longer count. Pinned SPECIFIC: 'The lint step in scripts/check.ts exits as soon as oxlint reports its first error.', 'The reviewer retry loop in src/core/services/review.ts eventually times out after 30 s; cap it at 3 attempts.', 'Replace the TBD markers in docs/architecture.md with the measured limits.', 'Rename the "sometime" enum value in src/shared/domain/schedule.ts to "unscheduled".'; earlier vague cases stay vague (generic scope words; leading deferral). Docs updated.
- **N1**: experimentEvents.test.ts 'refuses statuses of one experiment recorded on two machines' (forkedStatuses), 'refuses an arriving event citing a report revision the reports stored here do not hold' (mergeClash eventProblem), 'refuses arriving events whose run history changed a report's content' (changedReport ?? experimentClash), 'refuses an event taking the number of a stored event that arrives with other content' ('takes number N').
- **N2 (owner deadlock)**: not reachable through the app, no code change. For mergeClash to refuse wrongly the owner needs an unexported event citing a report revision missing from the tracked file while that file holds another machine's events. Only a follow-up run's owner appends to another machine's run; follow-up epics exist only for completed epics (createCorrections; markers cannot be forged any more), so the source run is complete and gets no new reports; all its report revisions were queued for export before the follow-up existed, and the export guard blocks the other machine unless it imported the current file while the owner always writes all its reports. Only a hand-edited or rolled-back file reaches it.
- **N3**: experimentOutcome.test.ts 'does not hold a stated value against an improvement…' (a stated result is not counted as unread); sourceCheckout.test.ts 'DM-189 c2: a case-only rename (renamed) versus a link that leads elsewhere (relocated)' — 'classifies a checkout renamed by letter case only as renamed, naming its new spelling', 'refuses a path handed to associate in another letter case as renamed, not relocated' (skipIf case-sensitive fs; ran here), 'classifies a path replaced by a link to another folder of the same name in another case as relocated'. No product defect.
- **N4**: docs/architecture.md (the holder of the cut events imports the shorter history and exports them again; renumbered events; draft listing, third machines, 'takes number', stated values); services/experiments.ts recordingRun comment corrected.
- **N5**: no more hash guessing: the import stores each report's content as written in the file (RunFiles.written; hashes to contentHash), the export writes the stored content unchanged (writtenContent/REPORT_DEFAULTS deleted), readers fill defaults via portable.ts filledReportContent (services/reports.ts reportView). No migration. Tests: experimentRecords.test.ts A->B->C top-level (followUps absent) and nested (followUps[{title}] without body: B reads body '' and risks []); C imports both.

### Mutation record (fix round; each restored)
- importer.ts renumber check requires an exact match -> 'takes the new number of an event it imported under the old one…', 'refuses an event taking the number of a stored event…'.
- experimentOutcome.ts draft filter removed from landingOf -> both R3/DM-187 tests; stated values counted as unreadable -> 'does not hold a stated value against an improvement…'.
- importer.ts forkedStatuses never refuses / mergeClash event check off / changedReport dropped from mergeClash / 'takes number' refusal off -> the four N1 tests respectively.
- experiments.ts DEFERRED back to unanchored adverbs -> the 4 new specific tests + 'says why: a leading deferral…'.
- importer stores filled content / reportView reads without filling -> both A->B->C tests.
- sourceCheckout.ts rename check never succeeds -> 2 rename tests; only last folder name compared case-insensitively -> the relocated test.

### Checks (after merging space-sprint-1 693d5fe)
- vitest (DM_DESKTOP_PIPE/DM_SESSION_TOKEN unset): 14 new files + src/core/{repo,services,plan,space,db}, mcp server/validation, capabilities, integration/sprintRetro, renderer/src/checkpoint, main/desktop — see submission for counts; shuffle run of the new files passed.
- npx oxlint on every src file changed vs space-sprint-1: exit 0. npm run typecheck: clean.
- scratch/DM-187 (c1-chain, c2-plan, c3-recovery, c3-review-fixes, c4-no-work) and scratch/DM-191 (c1-destination, c1-self-target, c2-integrity, c2-recovery, c3-no-execution, c4-measure), sequentially: all ALL CHECKS PASSED.
